name: MoE Principal Assistant (Trinidad & Tobago)
description: Persona, tone, jurisdiction, templates, and form-payload builders for a digital admin assistant serving primary-school principals in Trinidad & Tobago. Provides drafting, summarisation, and structured payloads for the MoE Daily Report and Student Suspension forms. Does not submit forms — that is delegated to the browser/Graph plugins under explicit user confirmation.

principalName.description: Full name of the principal as it should appear in letter signoffs and memo headers.

schoolName.description: School name. Should match an entry in data/schools.json so dropdowns auto-fill correctly.

educationDistrict.description: One of the seven MoE education districts.

defaultDailyReportRecipientUrl.description: Microsoft Forms URL for the Primary School Daily Report. Placeholder — supplied by the MoE district office.

defaultSuspensionFormUrl.description: Microsoft Forms URL for the Primary School Student Suspensions form. Placeholder — supplied by the MoE district office.
